title: Bedrock completions adapters: top_k is deliberately left unmapped, because Titan has no topK field and Jurassic's topKReturn only controls reported alternatives
answers: Why is top_k ignored when I call a Bedrock Titan or Jurassic model?
Can top_k be mapped to topKReturn for AI21 Bedrock completions?
Which MLflow gateway providers map top_k and which do not?
body:
Path: Completions requests to Bedrock Titan and AI21 Jurassic models that include top_k pass through AWSTitanAdapter.completions_to_model and AI21Adapter.completions_to_model in mlflow/gateway/providers/bedrock.py, where unmapped keys are forwarded unchanged rather than translated.
Rule: Do not map top_k to any Bedrock key for these families. Titan's textGenerationConfig has no topK field, and Jurassic's topKReturn controls how many alternative tokens are reported, so mapping top_k onto it would change the response instead of the sampling. The NB comments in both adapters record this; GeminiAdapter maps top_k -> topK only because Gemini supports it.
Symptom: top_k is accepted and silently has no effect on Bedrock Titan and Jurassic completions; this is a known, deliberate gap rather than a bug fix.
Constraints: Open question whether to reject top_k with a 422 as is done for n on Titan; the change kept it accepted to stay backwards compatible. Applies only to Bedrock Titan and Jurassic adapters.
applies: Bedrock Titan and AI21 Jurassic completions adapters in mlflow/gateway/providers/bedrock.py; does not cover Gemini or Anthropic top_k handling.
says: Setting top-k sampling has no effect on completions generated by Amazon Titan models.
Adjusting the top-k parameter does not influence sampling behavior for AI21 Jurassic completions.
Model gateway accepts top-k settings for certain Bedrock providers but silently ignores them.
Inquire why top-k configuration does not alter the output diversity of Bedrock models.
search: In mlflow/gateway/providers/bedrock.py, AWSTitanAdapter.completions_to_model and AI21Adapter.completions_to_model deliberately leave top_k unmapped because Titan lacks a topK configuration field and Jurassic's topKReturn controls reported alternatives rather than sampling. Completions requests forwarding top_k accept the parameter without error to maintain backwards compatibility, silently having no effect rather than raising a 422 validation error. This deliberate omission is unique to Bedrock Titan and Jurassic adapters, in contrast to GeminiAdapter which maps top_k to topK.
